name: thebigword Connector for Drupal
description: A TMGMT translator plugin that sends translation jobs to thebigword's professional translation service and pulls results back.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 Provides a thebigword translation provider for the Translation Management Tool project.

 thebigword Connector for Drupal enables automatic translation submission of new website content and retrieval of translated content. This transforms the management of multilingual websites into a single solution that supports professional global communication.

 Integration is setup within hours, minimising manual intervention and utilising quality enhancing solutions such as, automated workflows, translation memory and terminology management.

 thebigword Connector for Drupal delivers a multilingual content management solution which enriches global website experiences.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Translate any content on your site. 
 Supports the continuous translation TMGMT feature to automatically submit new and updated content for translation. (Drupal 8 only) 
 Supports previews of the translations in progress (Drupal 8 only). 
 
 Back to top 

 thebigword Connector solution advantages 
 
 Keep content up-to-date and engage effectively with a global audience 
 Experience intelligent automation and minimise manual intervention 
 Utilise quality enhancing solutions such as, automated workflows, translation memory, terminology management and CAT tools 
 Communicate easily with a cost-efficient localisation solution 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module requires TMGMT ( http://drupal.org/project/tmgmt ) module to be installed.

 Also you will need to enter the Client key. You can obtain them by registering on the thebigword.com 

 Back to top
